subject: Request to re-anchor MAP and shift close date (Nimbus evaluation)
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Procurement <procurement@nimbus-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to re-anchor MAP and shift close date (Nimbus evaluation)

Hi Olga / Laura,

Quick update from procurement: the legal review hit a new dependency (third-party data license) and procurement has pushed the contract close target out by two weeks. They now expect internal sign-off week of Aug 16, which would shift our close from Aug 5 -> Aug 19.

We still want to proceed with the evaluation and prefer not to lose momentum, but we need a revised MAP and confirmation of what we can compress in the evaluation window without impacting the SLA/canary gates. Can you: 
- Share an updated MAP that reflects a 2-week delay and identifies any high-risk milestones we should escalate?
- Confirm whether we can compress the performance eval from 10 days to 6 days while keeping a canary traffic plan?

Attached: Nimbus_SOW-comments.docx (procurement's redlines).

Can we get a proposed MAP update by EOD tomorrow so we can align execs here?

Thanks,
Samantha Cho
Head of Platform PM, Nimbus Analytics
Samantha.cho@nimbus-analytics.com
[Attachment: Nimbus_SOW-comments.docx]

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to re-anchor MAP and shift close date (Nimbus evaluation)

Samantha — thanks for the heads up and for sending procurement's comments. Attached is Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf with a proposed re-anchor to Aug 19 and a short mitigation column for each milestone. High level:

1) Condense evaluation window: We propose a 6-day performance/config eval (reduced from 10) + a 3-day staggered canary run. This preserves the core KPI checks while shortening the total calendar time.

2) Parallelize procurement-dependent items: Where possible we'll continue integration and test prep in parallel with legal to avoid idle work. We call out two prerequisites that must complete before final cutover: (a) data license approval, (b) production access for the test cohort.

3) Escalation triggers: If procurement doesn't sign by Aug 12 we'll open an exec review and request an SLA contingency (short-term early-access quota) so Nimbus can begin limited traffic ramp.

Please review the attached MAP and the inline risk register. I flagged three items as "high" that would require an exec touchpoint. If that looks good, Laura has authority to approve the rebaseline and I'll update the HubSpot deal (DEAL-5219) and DocuSign timeline.

Requested next steps:
- Samantha / Procurement: confirm night of Aug 12 as the hard cut for exec escalation.
- Nimbus: identify one test cohort (10–15 hosts) we can provision now.
- Redwood: we will circulate a trimmed evaluation checklist for the 6-day window by EOD tomorrow.

Olga Petrov
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf]

Quick question on the evaluation compression: can we keep the canary gating strictness the same (daily QA + perf threshold) and just reduce measurement windows, or do we need to alter thresholds because of shorter sample sizes?

If we keep thresholds identical, we should plan for a fail-fast canary and a rollback playbook. I sketched a short rollback checklist and an ammo list for the operations team — I'll attach that to the HubSpot notes.

Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 16:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to re-anchor MAP and shift close date (Nimbus evaluation)

Thanks everyone — appreciate the clear ask and the rapid plan.

After reviewing Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf and speaking with product/ops: Laura (exec) approves re-anchoring the MAP to a close target of Aug 19 with the compressed eval described. Conditions:
- Nimbus must confirm data license progress and share the nominated test cohort by Aug 2.
- If the license isn't cleared by Aug 12, Redwood will initiate the exec escalation path and hold a contingency call the next business day.
- Redwood will provide the trimmed evaluation checklist and the ops rollback playbook by EOD Mon (Jul 26).

Risks logged (brief):
- Data license (high): blocks cutover; triggers exec escalation.
- Reduced sample size (medium): increases false positives in perf deltas; mitigated with conservative canary thresholds and immediate rollback.
- Doc signing lag (low): procurement delay could push final invoicing — finance to be notified.

Samantha — once procurement confirms the cohort and date I will update HubSpot and queue the DocuSign timeline. I've also attached the approved MAP for your records.

Laura Bennett
VP, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0284
